steps.title: Establish Project Identity and Base Structures
steps.description: Initialize app-meta.json and build configs with target SDK 34 and dynamic package naming for HyperSpace 5D.

steps.title: Create Android Manifest with Relative Package Setup
steps.description: Declare MainActivity under the com.hyperspace5d.app package and map launch requirements.

steps.title: Design Volumetric Sci-Fi UI Layout
steps.description: Build layout incorporating a customized 5D projection viewport, multi-dimensional sliders, and responsive action triggers.

steps.title: Build Holographic 3D/5D Neobrutalist Drawables
steps.description: Formulate neon glowing strokes, deep cosmic space gradients, and physical bevel button styles.

steps.title: Define 5-Dimensional Vertex Arrays
steps.description: Structure math representations for the 5-Simplex, 5-Cube (Penteract), and 5-Cross Polytope.

steps.title: Build 10-Plane 5D Rotation Matrix Logic
steps.description: Compute rotations across the XY, XZ, XW, XV, YZ, YW, YV, ZW, ZV, and WV planes dynamically using sine and cosine matrices.

steps.title: Implement Cascaded Dimensional Perspective Projections
steps.description: Perform mathematical down-projections from 5D to 4D, 4D to 3D, and 3D to 2D screen coordinates.

steps.title: Develop Multi-Sensory Dynamic Sound Synthesizer
steps.description: Establish real-time sound synthesis engine using AudioTrack, mapping frequency sweeps to W and V slider scales.

steps.title: Program Interactive Slider and Control Binding
steps.description: Link UI seekbars, active shape selectors, plane rotation toggles, and coordinate readout text fields in MainActivity.

steps.title: Add Dynamic Ambient Space Clock and Dimension Randomizer
steps.description: Incorporate automated hyper-plane excitation, space metrics calculation, and random atmospheric cosmic quotes.

steps.title: Execute Strict Java 8 Compatibility Review
steps.description: Verify build compliance for Java 1.8 settings, confirming zero non-compatible APIs or lambda declarations are used.

steps.title: Building HyperSpace 5D
steps.description: Assemble, compile, and prepare deployment-ready packages of HyperSpace 5D.
